content:
alex_marketing: Quick sync  were rolling the updated benchmark + blog TOMORROW 08:00Z. Need final press FAQ, a 1-line CEO soundbite, and a partner excerpt for syndication. Legal + ops please confirm by EOD. @press_ops_bot run embargo checklist?

press_ops_bot: Embargo checklist initiated. Proposed embargo: 2026-04-01 08:00Z. Assets locked, access = marketing+press. No external share until release. :white_check_mark:

jess_editor: First-pass CEO soundbite: "Our goal is to make inference predictableso teams can deliver great products without surprise bills." Thoughts?

mira_ceo: Like the sentiment. Tighten: "We make inference predictable so teams can build reliable, cost-effective AI products."

jess_editor: Updated: "We make inference predictable so teams can build reliable, cost-effective AI products."

sam_seo: Draft short social copy: "New benchmark + playbook from Redwood: practical tips to cut inference cost and keep latency low. Read: <shortlink>"

sam_seo: Longer thread idea (4 tweets):
```
1/ We published a benchmark + playbook for serving LLMs in production.
2/ Includes batching, prefix caching, and quantization guidance.
3/ Case study: real workload, measurable unit-cost savings.
4/ Ops checklist and rollout tips: avoid surprise regressions. <link>
```

lisa_legal: Please replace any numeric savings with "up to" and reference the methodology link. Also add a confidentiality note to embargo assets: "Embargoed for distribution until publish time."

dana_prod: Press FAQ bullets (draft):
- What did you measure? A: Token-level unit cost and 95th P99 latency across conversational and retrieval-augmented workloads.
- How should customers interpret "up to" claims? A: Dependent on model size, workload mix, and cache hit rates; see methodology.
- Will this change Redwood pricing? A: No immediate changes; recommendations are operational best practices.

hope_growth: Partner syndication snippet (for partners to republish):
"Redwoods benchmark and playbook provide practical ops guidance for teams deploying LLMs at scale. Learn more: <partnerlink>"

michael_partnerships: We need a partner-safe link with UTM so we can track referral signups. Marketing, can you generate partner-specific URLs?

alex_marketing: Will generate UTM links and add to press kit. ops_oncall: Whats the production readiness checklist?

ops_oncall: Ops plan: enable surge autoscale 30m pre-publish, monitor error budget and token spend. Pre-bake a read-only lite-model fallback. On-call on #release-war-room. If token spend > thresholds, switch traffic to fallback.

lisa_legal: One more: remove any implication of SLA change. If we mention latency percentiles, qualify them as empirical observations from our tests.

jess_editor: Press Q&A (3 bullets) for media notes - please review:
1) "What workloads did you test?" -> "Conversational chat and retrieval-augmented search on representative web-text corpora; see methodology."
2) "How big are the savings?" -> "Up to 3x unit-cost reductions in specific cache-friendly workloads; results vary."
3) "Is this built into Redwood by default?" -> "Some optimizations are automatic; others require config and are documented in the playbook."

mira_ceo: :thumbsup: on Q&A. Alex, make sure partner links are ready and legal approves the partner snippet.

alex_marketing: Noted. Action items: (1) legal final sign-off by 17:30 PT, (2) partner UTM links by 18:00 PT, (3) ops to stage autoscale + fallback, (4) publishing assets uploaded to press drive. If no objections by 18:30 PT we lock and press_ops_bot will schedule embargo release.

press_ops_bot: Embargo scheduled for 2026-04-01 08:00Z if thread shows final signoffs. I will ping again at T-1h. :alarm_clock:
